arithmetic_contract.LF_identity: I(F) intersects I(E)+I(U). Equivalently |F-E-U|<=hF+hE+hU for closed independent envelopes. Baseline all q=.001 =>0.0015thousand. SDDS all coarse q=100 =>150thousand.
arithmetic_contract.unemployment: Official I(u) intersects [100*(U-hU)/(F+hF),100*(U+hU)/(F-hF)] with positive denominator. Baseline I(u) radius.05pp, hF=hU=.0005thousand.
arithmetic_contract.employment_participation: Let e=100E/N,p=100F/N. Then e/p=E/F, not e=E/F. Compare intervals [(e-he)/(p+hp),(e+he)/(p-hp)] and [(E-hE)/(F+hF),(E+hE)/(F-hF)] when p>hp,F>hF.
arithmetic_contract.assumptions: Same month, geography, age15+, NSA and sampling universe/vintage. Arithmetic is necessary consistency, not sufficient identity/official publication proof.

september_2026.interval_caveat: Quantization/model envelope only; not survey uncertainty, sampling confidence interval or vintage uncertainty. Raw Excel values do not justify statistical confidence of these digits.
